fighting-skill-low-kick.name: Low Kick

fighting-guts.name: Guts
fighting-guts.description: +25% damage while it carries a status.

fighting-moxie.name: Moxie

fighting-skill-close-combat.name: Close Combat
fighting-skill-close-combat.description: New skill: an all-out melee strike.

fighting-grandmaster.description: Fighting moves deal 20% more damage; a KO on its turn refreshes its basic attack.

fighting-vital-spirit.name: Vital Spirit
fighting-vital-spirit.description: Immune to Sleep and Slow; +1 HP.

fighting-counter.description: +25% damage on free strikes at fleeing foes; +1 Bond when one hits.

fighting-skill-focus-punch.name: Focus Punch
